employeeCount.description: Standalone employee count for the entity only. Integer for an exact value, string for a reported range such as '201-500', or null when no confident standalone count is available or no entity anchor was confirmed.

items.description: URL of a public source used to verify the employee count.

sources.description: URLs used to research the standalone employee count, including any secondary reference retained after a tie-break.

asOfDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the count was reported. Normalize a month-only date to the first of that month. Null when the source gives no date.

confidence.description: high: official or entity-owned source, anchor confirmed, no conflict, dated. medium: anchor confirmed but a tie-break was applied or no date is available. low: anchor weak or unconfirmed, aggregator-only source, or employeeCount is null.

parentConflationNote.description: Any source that conflated the entity with a parent, any combined-group figure excluded and why, and any tie-break applied. Null only when none occurred.
